question: What practice is enjoined for one who, after six months, takes up an ochre robe free from bondage?
premises: A time limit of six months is given.
A relative clause refers to one who takes up an ochre robe free from bondage.
That person is enjoined to practice.
inference: After six months, one who assumes an ochre robe free from bondage should engage in practice.
uncertainties: The object or content of the practice is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Indeed, one who, after six months, should practice, having taken up an ochre robe free from bondage.
